name: OPTel Training API
postCreateCommand: git config --global credential.helper '!gh auth git-credential' && go install github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.5.1 && go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.8.0 && echo 'export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin"' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin"' >> ~/.zshrc || true && (mkdir -p /root/.config/gh && cp -r /home/vscode/.config/gh/* /root/.config/gh/ 2>/dev/null || true) && chmod -R 600 /root/.config/gh 2>/dev/null || true
